row.headline: Fábricas Nacionales de Cerveza cierra la fábrica de Minas y analiza inversión de US$ 14 millones para planta de Montevideo
row.summary: Fábricas Nacionales de Cerveza is closing its factory in Minas and considering a US$14 million investment for a plant in Montevideo, affecting 59 workers currently on unemployment insurance.
